askRitm.title: Ask Ritm
askRitm.intro: Ritm is an AI assistant. Answers may be wrong, so check the numbers on screen. I can explain the pause, the numbers on your screen and your options. I won’t tell you what to buy: the choice stays yours.

suggestions.today: How much can I spend today?
suggestions.goal: How do I reach my goal?

askRitm.introHome: Ritm is an AI assistant. Answers may be wrong, so check the numbers on screen. I can explain your month’s pace, the numbers on your screen and your options. I won’t tell you what to buy: the choice stays yours.
askRitm.error: I couldn’t answer right now. Check your connection and try again.
askRitm.disclaimer: Ritm explains; it doesn’t decide for you.

welcome.title: Welcome to Atlas
welcome.lead: Atlas is a made-up bank. Ritm is the idea we are showing: it helps your salary last until the next one, without blocking anything.

d1.title: Payday
d1.body: Turn on Ritm in 3 steps and choose how strict it is.

d6.title: Money goes too fast
d6.body: Ritm tells you early, and a big online payment can get a short pause.

d20.title: The Lock opens
d20.body: If you put money aside, it is yours again. You choose where it stays.

welcome.simulated: Everything is simulated: the money, the payments, the salary. Tap anything, and move from day to day with the clock at the top.
welcome.reopen: You can open this guide any time from Home or Profile.

s1.title: Your first salary is here
s1.l1: Ritm watches how fast your money goes since payday.
s1.l2: It tells you early if you're going too fast, not after the money is gone.
s1.l3: You choose how strict it is. You can turn it off anytime.
s1.data: Ritm uses the transactions Atlas already has. It never comments on health purchases.

pension.title: How Pillar III works
pension.what: A private pension you choose yourself. The money is invested in a fund until you retire.
pension.get: What you put in comes off your taxable income, up to {limit} a year (400 EUR, shared with private health insurance). For {amount}, your tax goes down by up to {tax}.
pension.catch: The money stays in the fund until age 60, after at least 90 monthly payments. The fund's value goes up and down with the markets, so there are no promised returns.
pension.fees: Fees: up to 5% of each payment and a small monthly fee on the balance. See the fund's prospectus.
pension.fund: Atlas Pensii is Atlas's own fund, not the only one. You can compare every fund on the
pension.consent: I understand this money stays in the fund until age 60 and I can't use it before then.

donePopup.note: The money stays in the fund until age 60, after at least 90 monthly payments. Atlas Pensii is Atlas's own fund; you can compare every fund on the ASF website.

join.title: Join Atlas Pensii
join.intro: To put money in a pension fund, you first join it by signing an adhesion act. It takes about 2 minutes.
join.agent: Atlas is registered with ASF as a marketing agent for Atlas Pensii, the pension fund of the Atlas group.
join.s2: Investments: mostly government bonds, some shares. Risk: medium.
join.s3: Fees: up to 5% of each payment and a small monthly fee on the balance.
join.s4: Payout: from age 60, after at least 90 monthly payments. With fewer, you get a lump sum instead of a pension.
join.s5: You can stop paying anytime and move to another fund.
join.read: I read the prospectus summary and I want to sign the adhesion act.
join.signed: Adhesion act signed. You're now a member of Atlas Pensii.
